lines.trans: Wait—I know that red-and-gold tin box! My aunt kept holiday almond biscuits in it!
Look at the strip of white cloth tape wrapped around the rim of the lid.
There are words written in faded black ink right across the top of the tin!
Pull down my glasses—no, here they are—let me read my family handwriting!
What does the label on the lid say, Zhou?
It says: Time Capsule of Room Eight and Room Nine, May, for a sunny morning.
They really left this box waiting for the week Room Nine opened again!
Try lifting the corner of the lid, Qing—will it open by hand?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最上面 ('the very top').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Formal preposition/conjunction yǔ ('with; and').

examples.text: 他不宜与艺人见面。
examples.trans: He should not meet with artists.

examples.text: 这事与你无关。
examples.trans: This matter has nothing to do with you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ yuè. Fifth month of the year ('month five').

examples.text: 五月的成都院子里到处都是花香。
examples.trans: In May, courtyards in Chengdu are filled with the scent of flowers everywhere.

examples.text: 这张旧照片是五月的一个晴天拍的。
examples.trans: This old photo was taken on a sunny day in May.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yà má. Combines 亚 ('flax/linseed') + 麻 ('hemp/plant fiber'); used for natural woven linen cloth (亚麻桌布 'linen tablecloth').

examples.text: 四块白亚麻桌布都已经熨得平平整整了。
examples.trans: All four white linen tablecloths have already been ironed nice and flat.

examples.text: 夏天铺上透气的亚麻桌布，整个阳光房都显得格外清爽。
examples.trans: With breathable linen tablecloths laid out in summer, the whole sunroom looks extra fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā men. Third-person plural pronoun for male or mixed groups.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以前的日子 ('days in the past').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Did your family live near here once?

related.gloss: days in the past (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng. Rays of light or brightness (阳光 'sunlight', 灯光 'lamplight').

examples.text: 早上的光从玻璃窗照进阳光房里。
examples.trans: Morning light shines through the glass windows into the sunroom.

examples.text: 换上新灯泡以后，屋子里的光很柔和。
examples.trans: After putting in the new bulb, the light in the room is very gentle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā. Cardinal number 8.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dòng. Used for physical movement (别动 'don't move!').

examples.text: 全都别动！现在几点？九点三十五分！
examples.trans: Hold everything! What time is it right now? Nine thirty-five!

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu. Describes thick coats, walls, books, or blankets.

examples.text: 我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
examples.trans: I have a thick quilt on my bed, so sleeping tonight is very comfortable.

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào. Introduces a person's given or full name (我叫小晴 'My name is Xiaoqing') or calls a cab.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu bian. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 右边 ('the right side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎo. Used for biting into food or mechanical threads gripping tightly.

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

examples.text: 他咬了一口热乎乎的面包。
examples.trans: He took a bite of the warm bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ò. Signals realization or acknowledgment.

examples.text: 哦？我的预订有问题吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Is there a problem with my booking?

examples.text: 我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
examples.trans: Me? Oh, I simply love punctuality! Seven fourteen is a lovely minute!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: quān. Counts full turns of a key, wrench, or lap around a block (一圈 'one full turn').

examples.text: 一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
examples.trans: One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.

examples.text: 我绕着广场走了一圈。
examples.trans: I walked one lap around the square.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mò shuǐ. Liquid writing ink for fountain pens. Measure word: 瓶 (píng, 'bottle').

examples.text: 这页旧信是用深蓝色墨水写的。
examples.trans: This old letter page was written in dark blue ink.

examples.text: 桌上的钢笔没墨水了，我得去加一点。
examples.trans: The fountain pen on the desk is out of ink; I need to refill it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū gu. Specifically father's sister (second syllable neutral tone); distinct from 阿姨 / 姨妈 (mother's sister).

examples.text: 周经理的姑姑以前也住在这座老院子里。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's paternal aunt used to live in this old courtyard too.

examples.text: 我姑姑年轻的时候最喜欢弹钢琴。
examples.trans: When my aunt was young, she loved playing the piano most of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字 ('a written character').

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jì. Literally 'character traces' (字 + 迹): a person's recognizable script on paper.

examples.text: 虽然过了三十年，墨水字迹还是很清楚。
examples.trans: Even after thirty years, the ink handwriting is still crystal clear.

examples.text: 我一眼就认出了爷爷本子上的字迹。
examples.trans: I recognized the handwriting in my grandfather's notebook at first glance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular pronoun for objects, animals, and places.

examples.text: 是啊，宋老师，还在等它的主人呢。
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, still waiting for its owner.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个家 ('a home').

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
examples.trans: Look beside ours: Courtyard width, street noise, quiet score nine points!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ bian. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 左边 ('the left side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块布 ('a piece of cloth').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 请拿一块干净的布擦桌子。
examples.trans: Please take a clean cloth to wipe the table.

related.gloss: a piece of cloth (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi fàng. Describes opening a courtyard, garden, or café to visitors.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 比现在翻一倍！我们真的要对整条街开放小院咖啡馆吗？
examples.trans: Double what I bake now! Are we really opening the courtyard café to our whole street?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn nian. Softened reduplication of 念 ('read out').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 字太小了，你帮我念念信上写的什么。
examples.trans: The print is tiny—read aloud for me what the letter says.

meanings.note: Pinyin: màn màn. Polite host phrase: 慢慢吃 ('take your time eating'), 慢慢走 ('walk safely').

examples.text: 凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
examples.trans: Cool? Ah—yes! Old-street water pipes need a gentle morning warm-up!

examples.text: 把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
examples.trans: Turn the blue wheel open slowly to the left—not too fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双手 ('a pair of hands').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

related.gloss: a pair of hands (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ kāi. Result compound for opening suitcases, envelopes, boxes, or laptops.

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lā. Opposite of 推 ('push'); used for pulling doors, shutters, or suitcase handles.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 让我把眼镜从额头上拉下来……九号房？！
examples.trans: Let me pull my glasses down from my forehead... Room Nine?!

掀开.gloss: lift open; fold back (a flap, lid, or cloth)

meanings.en: lift open; fold back (a flap, lid, or cloth)
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān kāi. Resultative verb joining 掀 ('lift a cover or corner') + 开 ('open').

examples.text: 先掀开左边蜡布，再掀开右边，里面的红金铁盒就露出来了！
examples.trans: Fold back the left flap of waxed cloth, then the right, and out gleams the red-and-gold tin box!

examples.text: 小美轻轻掀开蒸笼盖子，热腾腾的甜香飘满厨房。
examples.trans: Mei gently lifted the steamer lid, filling the kitchen with warm sweet fragrance.

掀起.gloss: set off, spark, stir up (a wave or trend)

meanings.en: set off, spark, stir up (a wave or trend)
meanings.note: Often paired with 热潮 or 讨论.

examples.text: 这档旅行真人秀在业内掀起了本土原创热潮。
examples.trans: This travel reality show sparked a boom in domestic originals.

examples.text: 决赛之夜的即兴主持在网上掀起了热烈讨论。
examples.trans: The finale's impromptu hosting set off heated buzz online.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duàn. Often a result after another verb: 烧断 ('burn through'), 摔断 ('break in a fall').

examples.text: 是旧电线，把一楼的保险丝烧断了。
examples.trans: It was the old wire—it blew the ground-floor fuse.

examples.text: 电话突然断了。
examples.trans: The phone call suddenly cut off.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Describes old houses, pipes, or letters—never a person's age (use 老 for people).

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo chén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个早晨 ('an early morning').

examples.text: 小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
examples.trans: Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.

examples.text: 雨后的早晨，院子里全是草木清香。
examples.trans: On a morning after rain, the courtyard is filled with fresh greenery.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí jiān jiāo náng. Compound 时间 ('time') + 胶囊 ('capsule'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 出远门回家以前，我和您姑姑藏了一个小铁盒时间胶囊。
examples.trans: Before my long journey home, your aunt and I hid a small tin time capsule.

examples.text: 时间胶囊里装着三十年前的手绘地图和一张旧照片。
examples.trans: Inside the time capsule were a thirty-year-old hand-drawn map and an old photograph.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qíng lǎng. Describes bright skies after rain.

examples.text: 小晴早！经理您好！雨后的早晨真晴朗。
examples.trans: Morning, Qing! Hello, Manager! How bright the morning is after the rain.

examples.text: 下了一夜雨，今天终于晴朗起来了。
examples.trans: After raining all night, the sky has finally cleared up today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng rén. Combines 杏 ('apricot/almond') + 仁 ('nut kernel').

examples.text: 小美端来了一盘刚出炉的温热杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: Mei brought over a plate of warm almond biscuits fresh from the oven.

examples.text: 用杏仁粉做的柠檬挞底吃起来特别香酥。
examples.trans: A lemon tart crust made with ground almonds tastes wonderfully crisp and nutty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biāo qiān. Combines 标 ('mark/sign') + 签 ('inscribed slip/tag'); measure word: 张 (zhāng); verb: 贴标签 ('stick on a label').

examples.text: 睡觉以前，先把那两个神秘白罐子都贴上清楚的大红标签。
examples.trans: Before going to bed, stick clear bright red labels onto both of those mysterious white jars.

examples.text: 贴好“白糖”和“海盐”的标签以后，早上做点心就再也不会拿错了。
examples.trans: Once the 'Sugar' and 'Sea Salt' labels are stuck on, nobody will mix them up during morning baking.

meanings.note: Pinyin: háo mǐ. Metric unit taking numbers directly without 个.

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 一定看准里面铜圈是二十毫米宽。
examples.trans: Make sure the brass ring inside is twenty millimetres wide.

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

涂.gloss: spread on; coat; brush on (wax, paint, or glaze)

meanings.en: spread on; coat; brush on (wax, paint, or glaze)
meanings.note: Pinyin: tú. Action verb for applying a smooth layer of beeswax, butter, glaze, or paint onto a surface.

examples.text: 在厚亚麻布上涂一层蜂蜡，雨水就渗不进去了。
examples.trans: Coat heavy linen cloth with a layer of beeswax, and rainwater cannot seep inside.

examples.text: 小美在温热的蛋糕表面轻轻涂了一层金黄蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Mei gently brushed a coat of golden honey over the top of the warm cake.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī qì. Uncountable noun (一点湿气 / 一滴湿气 'a trace/drop of dampness'); joins 湿 ('wet') + 气 ('vapour, air').

examples.text: 蜡布封得真严实，铁盒里面连一点湿气都没有。
examples.trans: The waxed cloth sealed it so snugly that not a trace of dampness reached inside the tin.

examples.text: 成都春天有时候湿气重，饼干一定要放进密封铁盒。
examples.trans: Spring in Chengdu can be damp at times, so biscuits should always go into an airtight tin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dī. Used as a verb ('drip') or measure word for drops of liquid.

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú gěi. Verb + recipient marker 留 ('keep/leave behind') + 给 ('for/to').

examples.text: 小美把最后两块柠檬塔留给了修电线的老陈。
examples.trans: Mei saved the last two lemon tarts for Chen while he rewired the room.

examples.text: 靠窗最安静的那张桌子留给宋老师吧。
examples.trans: Let's keep the quietest table by the window for Teacher Song.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái. Describes white paper, sugar, or tablecloths.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个盒子 ('a small box').

examples.text: 搬家公司清空房子之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared the house, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 这个小木头盒子装的是老照片。
examples.trans: This little wooden box holds old photographs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gài zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个木头盖子 ('a wooden lid').

examples.text: 开了！老陈，快打开木头盖子！
examples.trans: It's open! Chen, quick, lift the wooden lid!

examples.text: 盖子要小心一点——它已经关了几十年了。
examples.trans: Careful with the lid—it has been closed for decades.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: miǎo zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 几秒钟 ('a few seconds').

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎn yòng. Colloquial stative adjective/verb 管 ('govern/take care of') + 用 ('use/function').

examples.text: 垫着枕头歇了两天真管用——今天一点也不疼了！
examples.trans: Resting two days propped on pillows really worked wonders—it doesn't hurt a bit today!

examples.text: 老陈修门窗的小办法简单又管用。
examples.trans: Chen's little tricks for fixing doors and windows are simple and effective.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐn. Describes tightening a valve (拧紧) or a tight schedule.

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng. Describes the color red; note that 红茶 is what English calls 'black tea'.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xì. Describes slender tools (细镊子 'thin tweezers'), fine grit (细砂纸), or careful work.

examples.text: 明天早上给我一把细镊子和一点木工胶水就行。
examples.trans: Just give me thin tweezers and a little woodworking glue tomorrow morning.

examples.text: 春天的细雨轻轻落在院子的常春藤叶上。
examples.trans: Fine spring rain fell softly onto the ivy leaves in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Adverb jīngcháng ('frequently').

examples.text: 我经常听小谷在办公室说起您。
examples.trans: I often hear Xiaogu speak about you in the office.

examples.text: 总编室经常在深夜开会讨论新方案。
examples.trans: The editorial office often meets late at night on pitches.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shéng. General noun for twisted cord or twine (细绳 'fine string/twine', 棉绳 'cotton string'); measure word: 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo).

examples.text: 用一根干净的厨房细绳把百里香和欧芹绑在一起，煮完汤方便捞出来。
examples.trans: Tie the thyme and parsley together with a clean piece of kitchen twine so they are easy to lift out after simmering.

examples.text: 木牌上面系着一根结实的麻绳，正好可以挂在大门口的铁钩上。
examples.trans: A sturdy hemp cord is tied to the top of the wooden sign so it hangs right on the iron hook outside the gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shéng zi. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo).

examples.text: 包裹外面用一根粗糙的麻绳子紧紧缠着。
examples.trans: The parcel was tightly wrapped on the outside with a rough hemp rope.

examples.text: 小美找来一根红色的短绳子，把礼盒系上。
examples.trans: Mei found a short red string and tied up the gift box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chán. Action of winding or binding something around an object.

examples.text: 细细的金线缠在卡片的边缘。
examples.trans: A fine gold thread is wrapped around the edge of the card.

examples.text: 那只小猫被毛线球缠住了爪子，正急得喵喵叫。
examples.trans: The little cat had its paws tangled in the ball of yarn and was meowing anxiously.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo huā jìng. Combines 老花 ('presbyopia / farsightedness of middle age') + 镜 ('glasses/lenses'); measure word: 副 (fù).

examples.text: 周经理摸了摸额头问：“等等——我的老花镜现在是不是又架在额头上？”
examples.trans: Manager Zhou felt his forehead and asked, 'Wait—are my reading glasses perched up on my forehead again right now?'

examples.text: 老陈看细小的钢琴零件时，总会从口袋里拿出那副老花镜戴上。
examples.trans: Whenever Chen inspects tiny piano parts, he takes that pair of reading glasses out of his pocket and puts them on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo dài. Compound 胶 ('glue/rubber') + 带 ('tape/ribbon'). Measure word: 卷 (juǎn, 'roll').

examples.text: 老陈用黑胶带把电线接头一圈一圈包紧。
examples.trans: Chen wrapped the wire splice tightly turn by turn with black tape.

examples.text: 打包瓷器的时候，箱子外面要多贴两道胶带。
examples.trans: When packing crockery, put a couple of extra strips of tape around the outside of the box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jié rì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè). Joins 节 ('joint, festival') + 日 ('day').

examples.text: 客栈在每个传统节日都会挂上大红灯笼。
examples.trans: The inn hangs large red lanterns during every traditional festival.

examples.text: 中秋节是中国人团聚的重要节日。
examples.trans: The Mid-Autumn Festival is an important holiday for Chinese people to reunite.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng là. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài) or 层 (céng). Joins 蜂 ('bee') + 蜡 ('wax').

examples.text: 信封的开口处滴着一圈红色的封印蜂蜡。
examples.trans: The opening of the envelope is dripped with a ring of red sealing beeswax.

examples.text: 老陈用一块天然蜂蜡仔细打磨着木雕。
examples.trans: Chen carefully polished the wood carving with a piece of natural beeswax.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng. Read xíng when meaning 'that works / okay' (不行 'won't work'); read háng when counting lines of text (第一行).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng. Used for packing items into a bag/box (装进) or fitting hardware.

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuì sè. Joins 褪 ('to take off, to shed') + 色 ('color'). Can also be pronounced tùn sè.

examples.text: 阳光晒久了，墙上的旧海报已经严重褪色。
examples.trans: Having been exposed to the sun for a long time, the old poster on the wall has severely faded.

examples.text: 这件深蓝色的外套洗了几次后，有点褪色了。
examples.trans: After a few washes, this dark blue jacket has faded a little.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个角落 ('a corner').

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

examples.text: 信封右上角贴着一张邮票。
examples.trans: A stamp is stuck on the upper-right corner of the envelope.

解开.gloss: untie, unfasten, lift (a burden or knot)

meanings.en: untie, unfasten, lift (a burden or knot)
meanings.note: Loosening a physical knot or an emotional/heavy burden.

examples.text: 把误会说清楚，心里的结就解开了。
examples.trans: Talk through the misunderstanding and the knot in your heart unties.

examples.text: 他帮大家解开了困扰很久的难题。
examples.trans: He helped everyone untangle a long-standing puzzle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn de. Joins 认 ('to recognize') + 得 (complement particle). Usually used for recognizing people or familiar objects.

examples.text: 志鹏一眼就认得这是弟弟小时候的字迹。
examples.trans: At a glance, Peng recognized this as his younger brother's childhood handwriting.

examples.text: 小晴刚来客栈没多久，还不认得所有的常客。
examples.trans: Qing hasn't been at the inn for long, and still doesn't recognize all the regular guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì shi. Warm, low-pressure invitation to try something.

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 这把备用钥匙能不能开，插进去试试就知道了。
examples.trans: Slip this spare key in and try it to see if it unlocks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān yuán. Joins 边 ('edge') + 缘 ('hem, margin').

examples.text: 杯子的边缘缺了一个小小的口子。
examples.trans: There is a small chip on the edge of the cup.

examples.text: 这张旧地图的边缘已经磨损得非常厉害了。
examples.trans: The edges of this old map have become heavily frayed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèr. Spoken variant of 这里 ('here').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà xiē. Plural of 那个 ('those').

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 箱子里面 ('inside the suitcase').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chóng xīn. Read chóng here; placed before a verb to redo it from scratch (重新打开 'reopen').

examples.text: 等等——你想下星期五六点，重新打开九号房？
examples.trans: Wait—you want to reopen Room Nine next Friday at six?

examples.text: 写错了没关系，重新写一遍。
examples.trans: It's fine if you made a mistake; write it again from the start.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块金子 ('a piece of gold').

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

examples.text: 阳光下，铜招牌闪着金光。
examples.trans: In the sunlight, the brass sign gleamed gold.

related.gloss: a piece of gold (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiě. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铁 ('a piece of iron').

examples.text: 这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
examples.trans: This big iron wrench? Here you go.

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

related.gloss: a piece of iron (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐng shang. Combines 顶 ('summit/crown/top') + neutral-tone locality suffix 上.

examples.text: 我和志豪站在木梯子上，正好能够到顶上的拱窗。
examples.trans: Standing on the wooden ladder, Hao and I can reach the arched window at the top.

examples.text: 书架顶上放着一只装旧照片的木盒子。
examples.trans: On top of the bookcase sits a wooden box of old photographs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yán sè. Combines 颜 ('countenance/hue') + 色 ('colour/tint'); measure word: 种 (zhǒng).

examples.text: 你看我搅动铁罐里的颜色——就像梧桐树叶那样的深绿色！
examples.trans: Look at the colour in the tin when I stir it—deep green just like wutong leaves!

examples.text: 刷完两遍油漆以后，绿窗板的颜色在阳光下显得温暖又明亮。
examples.trans: After two coats of paint, the colour of the green shutters looks warm and bright in the sunlight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐng gān. Combines 饼 ('flat baked cake') + 干 (gān, 'dry'): dry baked biscuits or cookies.

examples.text: 小美烤了一盘温热酥脆的杏仁饼干配薄荷茶。
examples.trans: Mei baked a tray of warm, crisp almond biscuits to go with mint tea.

examples.text: 把剩下的饼干收进铁盒里，明天吃还是脆的。
examples.trans: Store the remaining biscuits in a tin so they stay crisp tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān liàng. Joins 鲜 ('fresh, bright') + 亮 ('bright, clear').

examples.text: 刚刷完漆的木门看起来非常鲜亮。
examples.trans: The freshly painted wooden door looks extremely vibrant.

examples.text: 小美穿了一件颜色鲜亮的黄裙子，像一朵向日葵。
examples.trans: Mei wore a bright-colored yellow dress, looking like a sunflower.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hēi. Describes black color or no light; 灯黑了 means the lights went out.

examples.text: 大厅的灯黑了！我把厨房的烤箱也弄坏了吗？
examples.trans: The lobby lamp went dark! Did I break the kitchen oven too?

examples.text: 天黑了，我们回去吧。
examples.trans: It's getting dark; let's head back.
